teaser.en: Snap a twig and white latex beads out, which is why one of its Digo names simply means 'the one with latex'.
teaser.sw: Ukivunja kijiti chake, matone ya utomvu mweupe hutokeza, na ndiyo sababu mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo lina maana tu ya 'mwenye utomvu'.
teaser.dg: Vundza chigongo na maziya mereru ganatuluka matone-matone; ndiyo mana dzina rimwenga ra Chidigo ra mmea uhu rina mana ya 'chiricho na ulimbo'.

summary.en: *Mzigande* is a shrub of the coastal forest and thicket, a relative of the periwinkles and oleanders, full of white latex. The Digo of Diani boil the root bark of its genus as a remedy for malaria.
summary.sw: *Mzigande* ni kichaka cha msitu wa pwani na vichaka vizito, jamaa wa *periwinkle* na *oleander*, kilichojaa utomvu mweupe. Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha gamba la mizizi ya jenasi yake kama dawa ya malaria.
summary.dg: *Mzigande* ni chitsaka cha matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani, ndugu wa *periwinkle* na *oleander*, chenye maziya manji mereru. Adigo a Diani nkuchemusha gopha ra mizi ya mimea ya jenasiye kuhenda dawa ya homa (malaria).

about.en:
*Mzigande* is a shrub of the dogbane family, and like most of its relatives it bleeds a milky white latex wherever it is cut. Its leaves grow in whorls, several leaves fanning out from the same point on the stem, which gives the branches a tiered, rosette-like look. The small white flowers come in clusters near the branch tips.

The whorled leaves and the latex together are the best field marks. Many plants in this family are poisonous, and the latex is treated with caution.
about.sw:
*Mzigande* ni kichaka cha familia ya oleander, na kama jamaa zake wengi hutoa utomvu mweupe kama maziwa popote kinapokatwa. Majani yake hukua kwa mizunguko, majani kadhaa yakitawanyika kutoka sehemu moja ya shina, jambo linalofanya matawi yaonekane kwa ngazi-ngazi kama rozeti. Maua madogo meupe huja kwa vishada karibu na ncha za matawi.

Majani yanayokaa kwa mizunguko pamoja na utomvu ndizo alama bora za kukitambua porini. Mimea mingi ya familia hii ina sumu, na utomvu wake hushughulikiwa kwa tahadhari.
about.dg:
*Mzigande* ni chitsaka cha jamii ya *dogbane*, na dza nduguze anjina anji, unalavya maziya mereru phophosi unaphokatwa. Makodzage ganamera manji phatu phamwenga kpwenye kolo, ganatawanyika kpwa mviringo, na ichi chinahenda panda zikale na ngazi-ngazi dza maruwa. Maruwa madide mereru ganamera mafungu-mafungu phephi na ntsa za panda.

Makodza higa ganayomera kpwa mviringo na maziya ndizo alama mbidzo za kuumanya. Mimea minji ya jamii ihi ina sumu, na maziya nkugbwirwa kpwa makini.

where.en: Look for *mzigande* in coastal forest and thicket on the south coast, where it grows in the shaded understorey among other shrubs and climbers.
where.sw: Mtafute *mzigande* katika msitu wa pwani na vichaka vizito vya pwani ya kusini, ambako hukua kwenye kivuli chini ya miti mikubwa pamoja na vichaka na mitambaa mingine.
where.dg: Hendza *mzigande* kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani ya kusini, ambapho unamera pepho photsi ya mihi mikulu kahi ya vitsaka vyanjina na mimea inayokpwera.

uses.en:
Among the Digo of Diani, the root bark of *Rauvolfia* is boiled to make a remedy for malaria. The practice is recorded for the genus as a whole rather than for this exact species.

*Rauvolfia* is well known to botanists for its strong alkaloids, which is one reason healers treat these plants with respect.
uses.sw:
Miongoni mwa Wadigo wa Diani, gamba la mizizi ya *Rauvolfia* huchemshwa kutengeneza dawa ya malaria. Desturi hii imerekodiwa kwa jenasi nzima badala ya spishi hii mahususi.

*Rauvolfia* inajulikana sana kwa wataalamu wa mimea kwa alkaloidi zake kali, na hiyo ni sababu mojawapo inayowafanya waganga kuishughulikia mimea hii kwa heshima.
uses.dg:
Kahi ya Adigo a Diani, gopha ra mizi ya *Rauvolfia* nkuchemuswa kuhenda dawa ya homa (malaria). Desturi ihi ikaandikpwa kpwa jenasi yosi, si kpwa aina ihi bahi.

*Rauvolfia* inamanyikana sana ni asayansi kpwa kemikalize kali, na ihi ni sababu mwenga inayohenda aganga agbwire mimea ihi kpwa hishima.

names.en: The main Digo name is *mzigande*. A second name, *chibombo ulimbo*, means roughly 'the *chibombo* with latex', and probably stresses that its sticky white latex is poisonous. No English or Swahili name has been recorded for this species. Scientists call it *Rauvolfia mombasiana*, after Mombasa.
names.sw: Jina kuu la Kidigo ni *mzigande*. Jina la pili, *chibombo ulimbo*, lina maana ya takriban '*chibombo* mwenye utomvu', na huenda linasisitiza kwamba utomvu wake mweupe unaonata ni sumu. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa kwa spishi hii. Wanasayansi hukiita *Rauvolfia mombasiana*, kutokana na Mombasa.
names.dg: Dzina kulu ra Chidigo ni *mzigande*. Dzina ra phiri, *chibombo ulimbo*, rina mana ya phephi 'chibombo chiricho na ulimbo', na chahi rinaonyesa kukala ulimbowe mereru unaonyata una sumu. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa kpwa aina ihi. Asayansi anauiha *Rauvolfia mombasiana*, kula dzina ra Mombasa.

reason.en: Another poisonous member of the dogbane family
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa sumu wa familia ya oleander
reason.dg: *Utsungu*, chitsaka chanjina cha sumu cha jamii ya *dogbane*

reason.en: Latex-bearing relative in the same family
reason.sw: Jamaa mwenye utomvu wa familia ile ile
reason.dg: *Muolaga kuku*, ndugu wenye maziya wa jamii mwenga

reason.en: Its root bark is also boiled for malaria in Diani
reason.sw: Gamba la mizizi yake pia huchemshwa kwa ajili ya malaria huko Diani
reason.dg: *Mtseha*, ambao gopha ra miziye piya nkuchemuswa kpwa homa (malaria) Diani

reason.en: Another root bark used against malaria
reason.sw: Gamba lingine la mizizi linalotumika dhidi ya malaria
reason.dg: *Chihumbohumbo*, gopha ranjina ra mizi rinarohumirwa kpwa homa (malaria)
